note: Snapshot of every variable in the PLUS Figma library, captured with figma.variables.getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync + getLocalVariablesAsync. Consumed by scripts/generate-token-registry.mjs to validate the Figma-variable -> CSS-token mapping, and held to a capture date by check:figma-snapshots. Refresh with `npm run snapshot:figma-variables`, which prints the probe to run in Figma, and `npm run snapshot:figma-variables -- --write <probe.json>`, which writes this file from what the probe returned.
